payload.text: (hv, 2026-11-25, in devbin-vc's window, answered at 16:59Z by devbin-vc's date -u; relayed by devbin-vc at 17:00Z and read by vc by 17:01Z on vc's date -u; not heard first-hand by vc; the options' wording vc's, the choice hv's and vc's recommendation) THE stale_at_check.sh FIX PARKS IN ST0084. stale_at_check.sh, a report-only gate tool in ST0056's parity tools, builds a thread's canon path by hand, so it refuses a thread that a person names by its shown id (item 5 of ST1c2db93's close sweep, reader C). The gate runs it with no id, and its fix needs a new test fixture, which a release does not add. hv chose (a) over (b), a fix in dc's sweep bank with a built pair in the existing test file: the fix goes to parked ST0084 with the other parity-tool defects (hv decisions 104 and 105), dc writes nothing more for it, and it is not in 3.5.4.
